main.LotteryId: kpi:lotteries, chart-rounds — counted per lottery; also the stable sort key
main.LotteryType: chart-years, kpi:units, insight:cont — first lotteries carry the flats and demand ratios; continuations re-offer leftovers
main.LotteryExecutionDate: chart-years, chart-demand, chart-price, chart-rounds, chart-groups, chart-native, chart-elig, chart-rep, kpi:years, insight:partial — year of the draw; partial last year detected from the data
main.LamasName: chart-cities, chart-city-demand, chart-scatter, kpi:cities, insight:city, insight:hot, insight:corr
main.LamasCode: skip: numeric code, one-to-one with LamasName
main.ProjectId: chart-status, chart-permit, insight:cont — distinct projects; latest lottery per project
main.ProjectName: skip: free-text project label (often plot numbers); searchable in the explorer
main.Neighborhood: skip: free-text neighbourhood label, 217 spellings; searchable in the explorer
main.MarketingMethodDesc: skip: near-constant (12 of 2,352 lotteries are מחיר מטרה, the rest מחיר למשתכן)
main.MarketingMethod: skip: opaque internal track code; MarketingMethodDesc carries its meaning
main.LotteryEndSignupDate: skip: inconsistent with the draw date (continuations inherit the parent's date, often months earlier)
main.ParentLotteryId: skip: continuation link; LotteryType and ProjectId already group the chain
main.WinnersHasryDiur: skip: always equals series A + B + C
main.WinnersBneyMakom: chart-native, insight:native, insight:native_odds — '-' (not reported) excluded and disclosed
main.Subscribers: chart-demand, chart-city-demand, chart-scatter, chart-rounds, kpi:subs, kpi:ratio
main.SubscribersSeriesA: skip: registration breakdown by series; the page breaks down winners instead, per-lottery detail in the explorer
main.SubscribersDisabled: skip: small quota count (0 in 77% of lotteries); per-lottery detail in the explorer
main.LotteryHousingUnits: chart-years, chart-demand, chart-cities, chart-providers, chart-rep, kpi:units, kpi:ratio
main.LotterySignupHousingUnits: skip: equals LotteryHousingUnits in 95% of lotteries; the drawn count is used
main.LotterySignupNativeHousingUnits: skip: signup-time twin of LotteryNativeHousingUnits, 25% not reported
main.PriceForMeter: chart-price, chart-scatter, chart-city-demand, kpi:price, insight:price, insight:corr — '-' and 0 excluded and disclosed
